web-guide-idea-108.audience: People who enjoy the atmosphere and craft of a chai stall.
web-guide-idea-108.offer: Show tea-making and the rhythm of the stall with the owner’s permission. Frame the work rather than customers’ private conversations.
web-guide-idea-108.steps.0: Agree filming boundaries with the owner.
web-guide-idea-108.steps.1: Show brewing, pouring and preparation during a manageable period.
web-guide-idea-108.steps.2: Explain a small detail and recap for new viewers.
web-guide-idea-108.equipment: A phone on a safe stand away from the stove, spills and customer traffic.
web-guide-idea-108.returnReason: Different times of day and seasonal drinks keep a familiar setting interesting.
web-guide-idea-108.promotion: Preview a cup being prepared with permission. Do not use customers as unconsenting characters.
web-guide-idea-108.metadataTitle: Chai Stall Chronicles — Creator Idea & Practical Guide · Saathum
web-guide-idea-108.metadataDescription: Show the rhythm of a chai stall, keeping customers and conversations off-camera unless they consent. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
